axi.name: 阿汐
axi.role: 影像拾荒者 · 据点管理员
axi.letter: 我把松开的分册纸脊重新折好，迟灯用铜尺压住边沿。册名写在纸上，片罐还放在原来的格子里；要换一行索引，不必搬动整架影像。
axi.english: I refolded the loose paper spine while Chideng held its edge beneath a brass ruler. The volume name stays on paper; the film tins stay in their old slots. Changing an index line need not move a shelf of images.

chideng.name: 迟灯
chideng.role: 放映站守夜人 · 旧设备修理师
chideng.letter: 我把盖沿旧布的接缝翻到内侧，线头夹进两层布里。阿汐用指腹顺着盖沿摸了一圈，才把片单的空白角压回去；纸上的片名，一笔也没擦。
chideng.english: I turn the cloth seam to the inside of the tin lid and tuck the thread ends between its layers. Axi runs a fingertip around the rim before setting it back on the film list's blank corner; none of the titles loses a mark.

mitu.name: 弥途
mitu.role: 盐环路标师 · 往返列站的递信人
mitu.letter: 我把两张纸签压在同一块木板上，免得风替我翻页。没走过的地方，铅笔先留着；纸上对过一遍，鞋底还得再走一遍。
mitu.english: I pin two slips to the same board so the wind cannot turn a page for me. I keep the pencil mark where I have not walked; matching paper still leaves the journey to my boots.
